entities.summary: Chukwuma Julian "Chuma" Okeke is an American–Nigerian professional basketball player for Real Madrid of the Spanish Liga ACB and the EuroLeague. Okeke played college basketball for the Auburn Tigers before being drafted 16th overall in the 2019 NBA draft by the Orlando Magic.
